To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the PEDOT/Th-G composite with 50 wt.% Th-GO showed the highest capacitance and good cycling stability.

the covalent functionalization of graphene oxide with thiophene monomer and its composite with PEDOT have been successfully synthesized and the composite with 50 wt % of Th-GO content showed the highest specific capacitances.

the composite prepared from covalently grafting of Th-GO into PEDOT chains exhibited a high capacitance, good cycling stability, and high conductivity, which is promising electrode materials for supercapacitors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of PEDOT/Th-G composites and their application as electrode materials for supercapacitor devices.
the synthesis of PEDOT/Th-G composite materials with a controllable structure and the investigation of their electrochemical properties.
the synthesis of Th-GO and its composite with PEDOT for supercapacitor application.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Th-GO could be an effective additive for the preparation of PEDOT/Th-G composite, which could be applied as an electrode material for high-performance electrochemical capacitors.
PEDOT/Th-GOs composites could be a potential electrode material for supercapacitor applications.
the composite material of PEDOT/Th-GOs can be a potential electrode material for supercapacitors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

Th-GO could act as a dopant for PEDOT and a template for the formation of porous structure, and the composite material could exhibit excellent electrochemical performance as an electrode for supercapacitors.
the covalently linking PEDOT chains with Th-GO can improve the electrochemical performance of PEDOT-based electrode material.
the Th-GO/PEDOT composite is a potential electrode material for electrochemical energy storage applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the covalent linking of Th-GOs with PEDOT chains is a promising approach to fabricate composite materials with high specific capacitance and excellent cycling stability for supercapacitors.
the composite prepared from the optimum Th-GO content (50 wt%) could be considered as a promising electrode material for supercapacitor application.
the covalent linkage of GO with PEDOT via Th-GO is an efficient strategy to improve the properties of PEDOT and to fabricate a high-performance composite material for supercapacitors.
